column4: 他向大家展示了自己的作品。
column5: He showed his works to everyone.
column6: 展示 is to put something on show for people to see: 展示作品 (to show works), 展示照片 (to show photos), 向大家展示 (to show to everyone).

column4: 这张照片展现出城市的美。
column5: This photo reveals the beauty of the city.
column6: 展现 is to bring something into view: 展现出 (to show), 展现美 (to show beauty), 展现在眼前 (to appear before one's eyes).

column5: This table takes up a lot of space.
column6: 占 is to take up space or to make up a share: 占地方 (to take up space), 占百分之五十 (to make up fifty per cent), 占座位 (to take a seat).

column5: Please wait for the train on the platform.
column6: 站台 is the platform at a station: 在站台上 (on the platform), 火车站台 (a train platform), 第一站台 (platform one).

column3: (of a phone line) to be busy
column5: His phone line is always busy.
column6: 占线 is "the line is busy": 电话占线 (the phone line is busy), 一直占线 (always busy).

column5: The price of vegetables has risen recently.
column6: 涨 is to rise in price or level: 价格涨了 (the price has gone up), 水涨了 (the water has risen), 涨工资 (to get a pay rise).

column3: to go up in price; to raise prices
column5: The price of milk at the supermarket has gone up.
column6: 涨价 is a verb-object word: 涨价了 (the price has gone up), 不涨价 (do not raise the price), 又涨价 (to go up in price again).

column4: 他唱完以后，大家给了他很多掌声。
column5: After he finished singing, everyone gave him a lot of applause.
column6: 掌声 is applause: 热烈的掌声 (warm applause), 一阵掌声 (a burst of applause), 给掌声 (to give applause).

column4: 他已经掌握了这个方法。
column5: He has already mastered this method.
column6: 掌握 is to have a firm grasp of a skill or of knowledge: 掌握方法 (to master a method), 掌握知识 (to master knowledge), 掌握情况 (to be on top of the situation).

column5: Please tell me your account ID.
column6: 账号 is the name or number that you log in with: 我的账号 (my account ID), 账号和密码 (account ID and password). 账户 is the account itself.

column4: 我的银行账户里有一点钱。
column5: There is a little money in my bank account.
column6: 账户 is an account that holds money or records: 银行账户 (a bank account), 账户里 (in the account). 账号 is the name or number of an account.

column5: He caught a chill yesterday.
column6: 着凉 is to catch a chill, often before a cold: 着凉了 (caught a chill), 小心着凉 (be careful of catching a chill). Here 着 is read zháo.

column5: The company will hold a conference next month.
column6: 召开 is to hold a meeting, in formal use: 召开会议 (to hold a meeting), 召开大会 (to hold a conference).

column5: The discounts at this shop are big.
column6: 折扣 is a discount: 有折扣 (to have a discount), 折扣很大 (a big discount), 打折 (to give a discount), 八折 (twenty per cent off).

column5: He studies philosophy at university.
column6: 哲学 is philosophy: 学哲学 (to study philosophy), 哲学家 (a philosopher), 哲学课 (a philosophy class).

column5: She is very sincere towards her friends.
column6: 真诚 is sincere: 很真诚 (very sincere), 真诚的朋友 (a sincere friend), 真诚地说 (to say sincerely).

column3: to be aimed at; to target
column4: 这个活动是针对孩子的。
column5: This activity is aimed at children.
column6: 针对 is "to be aimed at": 针对孩子 (aimed at children), 针对问题 (to target a problem), 针对…的 (aimed at …).

column5: This photo is very precious to me.
column6: 珍贵 is precious: 很珍贵 (very precious), 珍贵的礼物 (a precious gift), 珍贵的照片 (a precious photo).

column5: This is a true story.
column6: 真实 is true to life: 真实的故事 (a true story), 真实情况 (the real situation), 很真实 (very real).

column5: We must cherish our time.
column6: 珍惜 is to value something and not to waste it: 珍惜时间 (to treasure time), 珍惜机会 (to cherish a chance), 珍惜朋友 (to treasure friends).

column5: The doctor diagnosed him as having a cold.
column6: 诊断 is to diagnose: 诊断结果 (the diagnosis), 医生诊断 (the doctor diagnoses).

column3: (for a spell of rain, wind, etc.)
column5: A spell of rain fell outside the window.
column6: 阵 is a measure word for a short spell: 一阵雨 (a spell of rain), 一阵风 (a gust of wind), 一阵掌声 (a burst of applause).

column3: to fight for; to compete for
column5: Two children are fighting over a toy.
column6: 争 is to fight or to compete for something: 争玩具 (to fight over a toy), 争第一 (to compete for first place). It is mostly found inside words such as 争取.

column3: to strive for; to try to win
column4: 他努力争取一个好成绩。
column5: He works hard to try to get a good result.
column6: 争取 is to work hard to get something: 争取机会 (to try to win a chance), 争取时间 (to gain time), 争取做好 (to try to do it well).

column5: His room is very tidy.
column6: 整齐 is neat and in order: 很整齐 (very tidy), 整整齐齐 (neat and tidy), 排得整齐 (lined up neatly).

column4: 从整体上看，这个计划不错。
column5: Looking at it as a whole, this plan is good.
column6: 整体 is the whole: 整体上 (on the whole), 整体情况 (the overall situation), 从整体上看 (looking at it as a whole).

column5: He waited a whole hour.
column6: 整整 stresses a full amount: 整整一天 (a whole day), 整整三年 (three whole years), 整整一百个 (a full hundred).

column5: He wants to earn money to buy a house.
column6: 挣 is to earn by working: 挣钱 (to earn money), 挣工资 (to earn a wage). Here 挣 is read zhèng.

column4: 政府给大家提供了很多帮助。
column5: The government gave everyone a lot of help.
column6: 政府 is the government: 中国政府 (the Chinese government), 市政府 (the city government), 政府工作 (government work).

column5: The police did not find any evidence.
column6: 证据 is evidence: 找证据 (to look for evidence), 有证据 (to have evidence), 没有证据 (no evidence).

column4: 正如你知道的，这里很贵。
column5: As you know, this place is expensive.
column6: 正如 is "just as" at the start of a clause, in writing: 正如你知道的 (as you know), 正如大家说的 (as everyone says).

column4: 他拿到了汉语考试的证书。
column5: He got the certificate for the Chinese exam.
column6: 证书 is a certificate: 毕业证书 (a graduation certificate), 拿证书 (to get a certificate), 一张证书 (a certificate).

column5: He is very interested in politics.
column6: 政治 is politics: 政治课 (a politics class), 政治问题 (a political issue), 对政治感兴趣 (interested in politics).

column5: I have three pens.
column6: 支 is a measure word for pens and other long thin things, and also for teams: 一支笔 (a pen), 一支球队 (a ball team).

column5: This is a well-known company.
column6: 知名 is well-known: 知名的公司 (a well-known company), 知名学校 (a famous school), 很知名 (very well-known).

column5: This road is very straight.
column6: 直 is straight: 很直 (very straight), 直走 (to go straight), 头发很直 (the hair is straight). It also means "directly" in words such as 直接 (directly) and 直播 (live broadcast).

column4: 这场比赛在电视上直播。
column5: The match is broadcast live on TV.
column6: 直播 is to broadcast live: 直播比赛 (to broadcast a match live), 网上直播 (to livestream online), 看直播 (to watch a live broadcast).

column4: 他刚进入职场，什么都要学。
column5: He has just entered the workplace and needs to learn everything.
column6: 职场 is the world of work: 进入职场 (to enter the workplace), 职场生活 (life at work), 职场上 (in the workplace).

column4: 这家工厂有一百名职工。
column5: This factory has one hundred workers.
column6: 职工 are the workers of a factory or an organisation: 工厂职工 (factory workers), 公司职工 (company staff), 一名职工 (a worker).

column4: 大家都要执行这个规定。
column5: Everyone must carry out this rule.
column6: 执行 is to carry out an order, a plan or a rule: 执行规定 (to carry out a rule), 执行计划 (to carry out a plan), 严格执行 (to carry out strictly).

column4: 我们到这里为止，今天的课结束了。
column5: We stop here; today's class has ended.
column6: 止 is "to stop", and it is mostly found in words and set phrases: 到…为止 (up to …, until …), 停止 (to stop), 禁止 (to forbid).

column5: The teacher guides us in writing essays.
column6: 指导 is to guide someone with advice: 指导学生 (to guide students), 在老师的指导下 (under the teacher's guidance), 指导老师 (a supervisor).

column4: 这家店从周一至周五开门。
column5: This shop is open from Monday to Friday.
column6: 至 is "to" or "until" in writing: 从…至… (from … to …), 至今 (until now), 至少 (at least).

column5: This medicine can treat colds.
column6: 治 is to treat an illness: 治病 (to cure an illness), 治感冒 (to treat a cold), 治好 (to cure).

column4: 我们要一起制订学习计划。
column5: We need to draw up a study plan together.
column6: 制订 and 制定 are both read zhìdìng. 制订 is more for plans and drafts: 制订计划 (to draw up a plan), 制订办法 (to work out a method).

column5: The school has laid down new rules.
column6: 制定 is more for rules, laws and standards: 制定规定 (to lay down rules), 制定标准 (to set a standard), 制定办法 (to work out a method).

column4: 这家公司的制度很严格。
column5: This company's system is very strict.
column6: 制度 is a system of rules: 公司制度 (company rules), 学校制度 (the school system), 新制度 (a new system).

column5: Old people have a lot of wisdom.
column6: 智慧 is wisdom: 有智慧 (to have wisdom), 人的智慧 (human wisdom), 智慧的人 (a wise person).

column4: 这件事我至今没有忘记。
column5: I have not forgotten this matter until now.
column6: 至今 is "until now": 至今没有 (not until now), 至今还 (still to this day), 至今为止 (up to now).

column5: The doctor is treating his illness.
column6: 治疗 is medical treatment: 治疗感冒 (to treat a cold), 接受治疗 (to receive treatment), 治疗方法 (a treatment method).

column5: He bought a smart watch.
column6: 智能 is "smart" for devices: 智能手机 (a smartphone), 智能手表 (a smart watch), 智能机器人 (a smart robot).

column5: He is a volunteer at the hospital.
column6: 志愿者 is a volunteer: 当志愿者 (to be a volunteer), 一名志愿者 (a volunteer), 志愿者活动 (a volunteer activity).

column5: This factory manufactures cars.
column6: 制造 is to make in a factory: 制造汽车 (to make cars), 制造问题 (to cause trouble), 中国制造 (made in China).

column4: 他们在制作一部新电影。
column5: They are making a new film.
column6: 制作 is to make something with skill: 制作电影 (to make a film), 制作蛋糕 (to make a cake), 手工制作 (to make by hand).

column5: The history of Chinese culture is very long.
column6: 中华 is a formal word for China and its culture: 中华文化 (Chinese culture), 中华美食 (Chinese cuisine).

column4: 中华民族有很长的历史。
column5: The Chinese nation has a very long history.
column6: 中华民族 is the Chinese nation as a whole: 中华民族的历史 (the history of the Chinese nation), 中华民族的文化 (the culture of the Chinese nation).

column5: I am studying intermediate Chinese.
column6: 中级 is intermediate level: 中级班 (an intermediate class), 中级水平 (intermediate level), 高级 (advanced).

column4: 我们通过中介找到了房子。
column5: We found a house through an agent.
column6: 中介 is a go-between or an agency: 找中介 (to find an agent), 中介公司 (an agency), 租房中介 (a rental agent).

column4: 这个项目已经到了中期。
column5: This project has reached its middle stage.
column6: 中期 is the middle stage: 中期考试 (a mid-term exam), 项目中期 (the middle of a project), 早期 (the early stage).

column4: 这里有来自中外的游客。
column5: There are tourists here from China and abroad.
column6: 中外 is "China and foreign countries": 中外游客 (Chinese and foreign tourists), 中外合作 (China-foreign cooperation), 中外历史 (Chinese and world history).

column5: This shop is in the city centre.
column6: 中心 is a centre: 市中心 (the city centre), 购物中心 (a shopping centre), 学习中心 (a study centre).

column5: He drinks a bowl of Chinese herbal medicine every day.
column6: 中药 is medicine from Chinese tradition, often made of herbs: 喝中药 (to drink herbal medicine), 中药店 (a Chinese medicine shop), 吃中药 (to take Chinese medicine).

column5: I want to find a Chinese-medicine doctor.
column6: 中医 is Chinese medicine, or a doctor of it: 看中医 (to see a Chinese-medicine doctor), 学中医 (to study Chinese medicine), 一位中医 (a Chinese-medicine doctor).

column4: 这家店的蛋糕种类很多。
column5: This shop has many kinds of cakes.
column6: 种类 is the kind or type: 种类多 (many kinds), 种类不同 (different types), 水果的种类 (kinds of fruit).

column4: 春天，农民把种子种在地里。
column5: In spring, farmers plant the seeds in the fields.
column6: 种子 is a seed: 花的种子 (flower seeds), 买种子 (to buy seeds), 种子很小 (the seed is very small).

column5: This matter is very significant.
column6: 重大 is of great importance: 重大的事 (a major matter), 重大问题 (a major problem), 重大变化 (a major change).

column5: There are numerous tourists here.
column6: 众多 is "very many": 众多的游客 (numerous tourists), 人口众多 (a large population), 众多朋友 (many friends).

column4: 这个包的重量是三公斤。
column5: The weight of this bag is three kilograms.
column6: 重量 is the weight of a thing: 东西的重量 (the weight of things), 重量是… (the weight is …). 体重 is a person's weight. Here 重 is read zhòng.

column5: Farmers grow corn here.
column6: 种植 is to grow crops: 种植玉米 (to grow corn), 种植蔬菜 (to grow vegetables), 种植花 (to grow flowers).

column4: 今年是我们结婚十周年。
column5: This year is our tenth wedding anniversary.
column6: 周年 is a year since an event: 十周年 (the tenth anniversary), 结婚周年 (a wedding anniversary), 一周年 (one year on).

column5: The farmer has kept many pigs.
column6: 猪 is a pig: 一头猪 (a pig), 猪肉 (pork), 小猪 (a piglet).

column4: 我们要逐步改变这个习惯。
column5: We must change this habit step by step.
column6: 逐步 is "step by step, in stages": 逐步提高 (to improve step by step), 逐步增加 (to increase step by step), 逐步学好 (to learn well step by step). 逐渐 is more "gradually, by itself".

column5: The weather has gradually become cold.
column6: 逐渐 is "gradually", for a change that happens by itself: 逐渐变好 (to get better gradually), 逐渐明白 (to understand gradually), 逐渐增多 (to increase gradually).

column5: Pandas like eating bamboo.
column6: 竹子 is bamboo: 一根竹子 (a bamboo stalk), 吃竹子 (to eat bamboo), 竹子很高 (bamboo is tall).

column5: Mum is boiling dumplings.
column6: 煮 is to cook in boiling water: 煮饺子 (to boil dumplings), 煮面条 (to cook noodles), 煮鸡蛋 (to boil an egg).

column5: He chaired today's meeting.
column6: 主持 is to host or to chair: 主持会议 (to chair a meeting), 主持节目 (to host a show), 主持人 (a host).
